in_hebrew.name: Evangeline
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bringer of good news
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Evangeline הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Evangeline is derived from the Greek words ‘eu’ meaning ‘good’ and ‘angeleos’ meaning ‘messenger’ or ‘bearer of good news’. In Christian tradition, the name is often given to girls born to parents who have received good news, such as the birth of a healthy child or a miraculous healing.
